name: YM2612
description: 16-bit FM-era YM2612 9-bit ladder DAC, Z80 PCM rate/jitter, and analog output stage emulator.

params.name: Model
params.explanation: Genesis hardware revision (M1VA2 = Model 1 VA2 warm, M1VA6 = Model 1 bright, M2VA1 = Model 2 muffled/clippy, RAW9B = unfiltered chip tap).

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: Z80 PCM / YM2612 sample-and-hold clock (0 = 4 kHz crusty speech PCM, 52 = 16 kHz Streets of Rage PCM, 100 = 44.1 kHz).

params.name: Bits
params.explanation: DAC bit-depth quantization (0 = clean 15-bit, 55 = YM2612 9-bit DAC, 67 = Z80 8-bit PCM, 100 = 4.5-bit crunch).

params.name: Ladder
params.explanation: YM2612 9-bit resistor-ladder zero-crossing discontinuity ('ladder effect' crossover buzz on quiet tails).

params.name: DMAJit
params.explanation: Z80 / 68000 DMA bus-contention sample clock jitter (59.92 Hz VBlank & scanline stutter).

params.name: Drive
params.explanation: Pre-DAC 9-bit digital rail & Genesis LM324/CXA1034P op-amp overdrive (auto-level compensated).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
